name: Devil Design (Devil Design Sp. J.)
summary: Polish filament producer based in Mikolow, Silesia, marketed in Polish retail as a 'Polski producent filamentu' (Polish filament manufacturer). Filament-only catalogue covering PLA, PET-G, ABS+, ASA, PA12, HIPS and TPU in 1 kg, 2 kg and bulk 5 kg formats, sold direct and through an unusually broad electronics-distribution channel (TME).

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Standard PLA; density 1.24 g/cm3 (ASTM D1505), softening ~50 C, elongation at break 160%, Spencer impact 2.5 J

product_lines.name: PLA MATT
product_lines.notes: Matte-finish PLA, a separate line from standard PLA

product_lines.name: SILK
product_lines.notes: Product card states SILK is a mix of PLA and PET-G, i.e. a genuine two-polymer blend rather than additive-modified pure PLA; density 1.23 g/cm3, very high gloss, very low shrinkage

product_lines.name: ASA
product_lines.notes: Density 1.07 g/cm3 (ASTM D792), Vicat 96 C, yield ~500 kg/cm2 at 20% elongation

product_lines.name: TPU
product_lines.notes: Shore 55D (ISO 868) - a hard TPU roughly equivalent to ~98A; no D-scale 55D grade id exists so the generic tpu id is used. Density 1.23 g/cm3, high resistance to oils/greases, not Bowden-friendly

additional_notes: Addresses seen in research: ul. Zwirki i Wigury 56E and 65, 43-190 Mikolow, Poland. Spool formats: 1 kg flagship, 2 kg industrial (limited colours), 5 kg custom/bulk with a 100 kg minimum order, and 6 x 0.33 kg starter packs. Distributed by TME (Transfer Multisort Elektronik) as an official line-card brand, an unusual channel for a filament maker. Lifetime warranty claimed on filament bought from official distributors; Bambu Lab print profiles are published. No build-plate or print-surface products found, so makes_plates is set false on absence of evidence. EU retail PLA around $18-20/kg (unverified against a price index), placing it at the budget/mid boundary. No official YouTube channel could be confirmed - only third-party unboxing videos - so none is recorded.

provenance.conflicts: In-house manufacturing is inferred from retail descriptions ('Polski producent filamentu') rather than a primary company statement; it remains unverified that Devil Design is not itself a private label of another Polish extruder. No oem_relationships are recorded because no counterparty could be named. Exact price per kg is unconfirmed.
